neighbours.label: ongoing or repeated action: 'keeps getting …', 'constantly', 'continually', 'always …ing' (the output direction of the opposite pole promotes ' continually', ' constantly', ' keeps'); one-off events stay quiet
fire: The backlog of unanswered emails just keeps getting worse.
Rents in the city are constantly climbing, year after year.
My little brother is always forgetting his lunch box.
The dictionary is continually revised as new words appear.
The hole in the fence keeps getting wider.
She is constantly checking her phone during dinner.
The guidelines are continually reviewed by a panel of nurses.
Traffic on the ring road just keeps getting heavier.
quiet: The backlog of unanswered emails was cleared on Friday.
Rents in the city climbed sharply in the spring of 2019.
My little brother forgot his lunch box this morning.
The dictionary was revised once, shortly after the war.
The hole in the fence was patched with wire yesterday.
She checked her phone once during dinner.
The guidelines were reviewed by a panel of nurses in March.
Traffic on the ring road was heavy after the match.

notes: Card: ' always' x7, 'would be' after 'Whenever', 'keeps getting', 'each evening', Chinese 'continually'. Probes: 'keeps getting bigger' 0.45, 'keeps getting longer' 0.40, 'continually updated' 0.35, 'constantly rising' 0.32, 'always nails' 0.30, 'always losing' 0.29; 'forever complaining' 0.09, 'kept growing' 0.07, one-off 'was flooded once' 0.04. Middling pole: fires sit at 0.3-0.45 of max, so the margin over the 0.20 median is small.
